svg.text: All live public-schema columns shown as oval attributes • PK underlined • FK marked • relationships on companion sheet
PK = primary key (underlined) • FK = actual foreign-key column • all 204 live columns are included; data types are in the companion physical ERD.
The relationship sheet uses one diamond per live foreign key. No relationship is inferred for users.auth_user_id or user_reviews.item_id.
